sentences.text: Rhinorex, meaning "nose king" from Greek and Latin roots, is a kritosaurin hadrosaur discovered in central Utah.
This genus contains only one species, Rhinorex condrupus, and belongs to the family Hadrosauridae within the subfamily Saurolophinae of the ornithischian class.
The holotype, the specimen the species is based on, preserves skin impressions alongside a mostly articulated partial skeleton.
This dinosaur lived during the Campanian stage, between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago.
It is hypothesized that Rhinorex inhabited more coastal environments than its relative Gryposaurus.
Fossils were found in the Late Cretaceous Neslen Formation, indicating a life span from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.

Phylogenetic analysis suggests Rhinorex is a close relative of Gryposaurus, with some researchers proposing it should be classified within that genus. The presence of Rhinorex challenges the hypothesis of provincialism in Late Cretaceous Laramidian dinosaur faunas.
